## Definition of done

Tick each item. If one does not apply, write "n/a" and why.

- [ ] Rules listed with IDs; each rule has a test
- [ ] CI green: code checks, tests, migrations, audit, secret scan
- [ ] Checked by hand in a browser at phone, tablet and laptop widths
- [ ] Behaviour matches the part's rules, or the difference is decided and
      recorded
- [ ] Docs updated in the same pull request
- [ ] No dead code, no stray files
- [ ] No real names, phone numbers or customer data
